credits.note: Pro includes {monthlyCredits} credits a month, and {packCredits} more cost {packPrice}. Your Coworker shows the cost and asks before it spends.

1.question: Do I pay credits to use Rerun?
1.answer: No. The plan covers Rerun itself: your Coworkers, their apps, memory, skills, routines and every run. Credits only pay for the Rerun models and paid data. A Coworker on your own Claude or ChatGPT plan or API key spends none.

2.question: What happens when I run out of credits?
2.answer: Coworkers on your own AI keep working. The ones on the Rerun models, and paid data, wait until the next month's {monthlyCredits} credits or a pack of {packCredits} for {packPrice}, which never expires.

3.question: Do credits roll over?
3.answer: The monthly credits of Pro reset each month, so what is left does not carry over. Credits from a pack never expire, and neither do the trial credits: what is left of them carries over when Pro starts.

4.question: Do I pay per Coworker or per seat?
4.answer: No. Pro has unlimited Coworkers and unlimited seats. Only the trial runs a limited number of Coworkers at once.

5.question: Is there a free trial?
5.answer: Yes, {trialDays} days with {trialAgents} Coworkers running at once and {trialCredits} credits. A card starts the trial and {free} is charged today. Cancel before day {trialDays} and you pay nothing.

6.question: Are LinkedIn and WhatsApp included?
6.answer: They are paid apps: LinkedIn Pro at {linkedinPrice} a month per account and WhatsApp Pro at {whatsappPrice} a month per number, on the same invoice as your plan. Every other app of the library is included.

7.question: Are templates included?
7.answer: The templates of the library are included, except those whose creator set a price: those are billed apart from your plan, and their page says so.

8.question: Do you charge per task or per run?
8.answer: No. Your Coworkers can run every hour of every day for the same price. Runs are never counted.

9.question: Can I cancel anytime?
9.answer: Yes, from Billing. Your Coworkers keep running until the end of the period you paid for, then the workspace is saved for 90 days in case you come back.

10.question: Are taxes included in the price?
10.answer: Prices are shown excluding tax. VAT or sales tax, when it applies to your country, is added at checkout. Add your VAT number or tax ID in Billing for your invoices.
